method: Normalized Hebrew contiguous-token alignment; exact anchors require runs of at least two tokens, with monotonic interpolation between anchors.

qualityOverride.basis: 333 exact contiguous-token anchors span all nine canonical transcript segments. Beginning, quarter, middle, three-quarter, and ending anchor contexts were inspected; the first exact anchor is at 14.31s and the last at 2868.45s of a 2892.02s recording. Only exact words are seekable, while interpolated words remain visibly distinguished.
